scripts.deploy:api:staging: pnpm dlx wrangler deploy --config packages/api/wrangler.toml --env staging
scripts.deploy:api:production: pnpm dlx wrangler deploy --config packages/api/wrangler.toml --env production
scripts.deploy:web:staging: pnpm --filter @taxdesk/web build && pnpm dlx wrangler pages deploy packages/web/dist --project-name taxdesk-web-staging
scripts.deploy:web:production: pnpm --filter @taxdesk/web build && pnpm dlx wrangler pages deploy packages/web/dist --project-name taxdesk-web-production
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
